name: Webster State Park (Goose Flat)
note: Goose Flat area of Webster State Park (KDWP), on the south shore at the west end of Webster Dam, reached by its own gravel road off K-258 just south of the dam: one row of electric-only back-in sites above a sand beach. Showers and flush toilets are at the north-shore campgrounds, not here. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: campitks.gov (2026-11-06): the 'Goose Flat' loop (510508) on parkID 519133 lists 6 sites, 088-093, all 'Standard with Electric Hookup' 30/20 A, site-specific reservable, 'Looking For Category: RV Site,Tent Site,Trailer Site', back-in, 'Maximum Vehicle Length' 40-54 ft, 088 concrete and ADA, 089-093 earth; KDWP's park map (search snippet, 2026-11-06) splits the park into the Oldtown Area (north shore) and the Goose Flat Area (South Shore). A separate place from 2087: on the opposite (south) shore across the reservoir, 2.4 km from the nearest west-cluster pad and 2.0 km from Rock Point, entered by its own road chain (OSM ways 13222585/13225366/13223629/13225290) from K-258 at 39.39197,-99.42226, south of the dam; no park road links it to the north shore (Esri imagery 2026-11-06). Public campground, no price gate. Hipcamp's 'no electric hookups' is contradicted by campitks.
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery 2026-11-06 at 0.26 m/px with all 6 campitks site coordinates plotted: the row sits on the reservoir side of the dam's west abutment, with an open shrubby slope (old wave-cut lines) dropping to a sand beach and the water ~55-60 m west of 090-093; 088 is ~120 m back in grass. 3DEP (USGS EPQS) transect: pad 090 579.7 m, 577.0 m at 17 m out, 575.7 m at 34 m, water 572.0 m at ~65 m; pads 088 582.5, 093 576.3 m. Reclamation's top of conservation pool is 1892.45 ft (576.8 m), so at full pool the shore would come within ~5-25 m of 090-093 with no road between - a possible open apron, but the pads sit atop a graded slope above the beach, campitks rates every site only 'Proximity to Water: Within 1/4 Mile' (not lakefront), and the lake was ~5 m below pool at both the imagery and the lidar; unsure, so down. All 6 are 'River/Lake View: Y' and the view west over open water is unscreened -> lakeview. Not below the dam: on the upstream side of the dam axis (K-258 on the crest is ~150 m east), pads at or above pool.

fees.note: KDWP's statewide schedule from November 1, 2026: a daily camping permit of $17.75 a night per camping unit, plus $11 a night for one utility (electric), so a Goose Flat site costs $28.75 a night. None is a designated prime site. A $2.75 processing fee per stay and a vehicle permit ($7 a day) are charged on top. Read 2026-10-15.

fees_source: https://ksoutdoors.gov/licenses-permits-fees/kansas-state-park-entrance-and-camping-fees (as quoted on sibling 2087, read 2026-10-15: 'Daily Camping Permit ... $12.75 per night $17.75 per night'; 'Utility Fees ... $11.00 per night for one utility $13.00 per night for two utilities'; 'Prime Site Fee ... designated sites on stays April 1-September 30 ... $2.00 per night'; 'a $2.75 processing fee will apply to each camping stay'; 'Daily Vehicle Permit ... $5.00 $7.00'); fee shape copied from 2087 (verified p3-308). campitks campsiteDetails for 088-093: 'Number of Utilities: 1', no 'Prime Site' attribute, read 2026-11-06.

min_stay.season: Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weekends (2027 rule)

booking.note: Sites are reserved site by site on Kansas's ReserveAmerica site (campitks.gov); the reservation window shown on 2026-11-06 ran from Nov 8, 2026 to Dec 6, 2027. Self-registration on arrival is also allowed. 2027 holiday minimum: 3 nights over Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends. Up to 14 consecutive nights in one campground, then move to another campground in the park.

booking_source: https://www.campitks.gov/camping/webster-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=519133 (park-wide '2027 CAMPSITES Holiday Minimum Stay Rule' 3 nights Memorial Day / Independence Day / Labor Day, '14 days maximum consecutive stay rule', 'Open year round.', as recorded on 2087 2026-11-06) and campsiteDetails.page?parkID=519133&siteID=<id> ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific', 'Self Reg Allowed: Y', 'Reservation Window: Sun Nov 08 2026 - Mon Dec 06 2027'), re-read live 2026-11-06 for siteID 3450, 3455, 3457, 3462
flags: hookups: electric 30 (30/20 A), water ABSENT (no Water Hookup attribute), sewer absent - campitks campsiteDetails 088-093 'Standard with Electric Hookup', 'Electricity Hookup: 30/20', 'Number of Utilities: 1', read 2026-11-06 (p3-308 per-site dump, siteIDs 3450-3455; 3450 and 3455 re-read live)

sites: count 6, max_rig_ft 54 (093), pull_through false (all 6 back-in, 40-54 ft), surface 088 concrete / 089-093 earth, ADA 088 - campitks campsiteDetails, read 2026-11-06. KDWP-side sources mention primitive camping here too; none is on campitks, not counted.

booking: reservable site-specific on campitks (ReserveAmerica), self-reg Y, window Nov 8 2026 - Dec 6 2027, max stay 14, 2027 holiday 3-night minimum - campitks campgroundDetails + campsiteDetails, read 2026-11-06
season: year_round true - campitks campgroundDetails 'Open year round.' (park-wide, as on 2087), and 088 takes bookings from Nov 8 2026, read 2026-11-06

facilities: vault_toilets true ('Vault Toilet: Within 1/4 Mile'). Showers and flush toilets NOT stamped: every site says 'Shower House with Restrooms: Outside Facility', 'Modern Restrooms: Outside Facility' - campitks campsiteDetails, read 2026-11-06
Elevation: Open-Meteo returns 572 m at the pin (its coarse cell takes the water surface); USGS 3DEP gives 576-583 m on the pads (090 579.7). Stored the Open-Meteo figure per the add rules.

Waterfront downgrade reported (unsure -> down): at full conservation pool the shoreline would come within ~5-25 m of 090-093 across an open slope with no road between, which could argue lakefront by the open-apron rule; I held it at lakeview because the pads sit atop a graded slope (~3 m in 20 m, then down to the beach), campitks rates them only 'Within 1/4 Mile', and the lake has been ~5 m below pool on every source. AWH may want a look.
